purpose: Separate who a person is from what they are wearing. Introduced after T04 run 001 (F02_WARDROBE_LEAKAGE).

coreDistinction.identityReference: Establishes face, body geometry and permanent markers. The avatar calibration photographs.
coreDistinction.wardrobeAuthority: Establishes clothing, footwear, bags and styling. NEVER the avatar calibration photographs.

referencePhotoWardrobeRationale: The calibration library was shot in plain crop tops, jeans, leggings and neutral underwear on a domestic terrace. That clothing exists to keep body geometry readable. It is not fashion direction and carries no PINK MALL assortment information.

wardrobeSourcePriority.description: Current canonical PINK MALL catalogue / active campaign assortment, generated at task time.
Explicit wardrobe reference supplied and approved for this campaign.

forbiddenFallback.rule: Avatar-source clothing is NEVER a fallback fashion direction.
onMissingAuthority: Request a wardrobe authority rather than inventing or copying one

wardrobeConfidence.rule: LOW whenever wardrobeSource is NONE. A fashion-led campaign without a current wardrobe authority CANNOT exceed LOW.

wardrobeLocks.meaning: Specific garment/colour/silhouette constraints that must survive generation.

wardrobeWarnings.meaning: Every styling element not backed by a wardrobe authority.

gate.wardrobeSourceValid: Must be true for fashion-led campaigns. False when wardrobeSource is NONE.

failureSignature.looksLike: Generated subjects wearing the calibration library's crop tops, wide-leg jeans and trainers instead of current PINK MALL assortment.
